releaseNotes:
- Rebalanced card groups: removed duplicate cardSamsungBoost binding, moved Disable Dev Options + Debloat into Tools; each card appears in exactly one group (no duplicates in 'All' view).
- Reset buttons enlarged 40dp -> 48dp tap target across all cards.
- Status lines get contentDescription for screen readers; active-summary now shows warning count.
- Onboarding gains a 4th step explaining view modes (list/grid/compact).
- Empty-search state copy improved.
- EN/PT parity clean.
